Finding 1 identifies exactly the corrupted substitution v_t = a_t x + b_t ε (missing the time derivatives a_t', b_t'), matching the ground truth's description of the incorrect velocity formula.

Neither finding addresses the issue of marginal velocity v(z_t,t) being replaced by conditional velocity v_t without justification/bias discussion around Eq. (10)-(11); both findings focus on different equations (the MeanFlow identity derivation and the v_t formula itself).
